title: DoD/NARA CUI Registry (embedded data source)
description: The full Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) Registry, scraped from the public National Archives CUI Registry (archives.gov/cui/registry) and embedded so the decision engine never fetches at decide-time (air-gapped target). Recognition is by `category_marking`; every other field is inert provenance captured for completeness and may be selectively ignored by the engine. This schema is the human-facing contract; build-time enforcement is wired separately.

version.description: Data-source version, typically the retrieval date (ISO-8601).

retrieved.description: Date the registry was scraped (ISO-8601 recommended).

groups.description: The organizational index groupings the CUI Registry sorts categories into (e.g. Critical Infrastructure, Defense, Nuclear).

categories.description: Every CUI category carried by the engine. Sorted deterministically by category_marking.

category.description: A single CUI category. `name` and `category_marking` are REQUIRED and non-empty; everything else is optional provenance (null or omitted when the source page does not expose it).

name.description: Human-readable category name (e.g. "Information Systems Vulnerability Information").

category_marking.description: The CUI category marking / recognition token (e.g. "ISVI"). This is the engine's recognition key.

banner_marking.description: The CUI banner marking shown on the category page (e.g. "CUI").

alternative_banner_marking.description: Alternative banner marking for basic authorities (e.g. "CUI//ISVI").

group.description: Organizational index grouping this category belongs to; a member of the top-level `groups` list.

description.description: The category description text from the registry page.

authorities.description: Safeguarding and/or dissemination authorities backing the category. May be empty.

last_reviewed.description: The "last reviewed on" date reported in the page footer (source's own words, e.g. "May 7, 2025").

source_url.description: Canonical archives.gov category-detail URL the record was scraped from.

authority.description: One row of the category's authorities table. All fields optional; missing cells are null.

citation.description: Safeguarding and/or dissemination authority citation (e.g. "44 USC 3554").

classification.description: "Basic" or "Specified" (the authority's control level), as published.

banner_marking.description: Banner marking associated with this specific authority.

sanctions.description: Sanctions text associated with this authority, when the page lists any.
